svg.text: One master playlist, six renditions, one control loop

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: the ladder is produced once per title; the player picks a rung per segment

svg.text: · Measure throughput over a 10 s window, not per segment.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · Step up one rung only with 10 s of buffer; step down two on a stall.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: · Cap at the display and at the plan’s max resolution.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: More rungs → smoother adaptation, but every rung is a full encode and a separate object in the manifest.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: 4K at 16 Mbps is 32× the 240p bitrate: the ladder is a cost decision as much as a quality one.
